description: The 404 page template, built only from library items: a centered hero with the light flowing in from the corners, the headline as a plain sentence, the search bar and the way home.

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/Button' import { SearchBar } from '@/components/product/SearchBar' import { FooterRow } from '@/components/site/FooterRow' import { SiteHeader } from '@/components/site/SiteHeader' import { HeroBlock } from '@/components/blocks/HeroBlock' import { notFoundContent, type NotFoundContent } from '@/lib/pages/not-found' import { cn } from '@/lib/cn' // The 404 page from library items: a centered hero with the light flowing in from the corners, the headline as a // plain sentence, the search bar and the way home. The page fills the window, the footer at the foot. `content` // replaces the copy (lib/pages/not-found.ts); `onSearch` receives the query. export interface NotFoundPageProps { content?: NotFoundContent onSearch?: (query: string) => void className?: string } const WRAP = 'mx-auto w-full max-w-page-wide px-12 max-sm:px-4' export function NotFoundPage({ content: c = notFoundContent, onSearch, className }: NotFoundPageProps) { return (
{c.home.label}} placement="center" light="corner" className="flex-1">
) } export default NotFoundPage

// The 404 page template's copy: short declarative sentences, a search and the way home. Both flavors read this file.
const nav = [
	{ label: 'Product', href: '/product' },
	{ label: 'Pricing', href: '/pricing' },
	{ label: 'Changelog', href: '/changelog' },
	{ label: 'Blog', href: '/blog' },
]
const footer = {
	domain: 'spyglass.so',
	links: [
		{ label: 'Product', href: '/product' },
		{ label: 'Pricing', href: '/pricing' },
		{ label: 'About', href: '/about' },
		{ label: 'Changelog', href: '/changelog' },
		{ label: 'Blog', href: '/blog' },
		{ label: 'Terms', href: '/legal' },
	],
}
const header = { nav, secondary: { label: 'Sign in', href: '/sign-in' }, cta: { label: 'Get 50% off', href: '/pricing' } }

export const notFoundContent = {
	header,
	eyebrow: '404',
	headline: 'This page is not here.',
	body: 'The link may be old or mistyped. Search for what you came for, or go home.',
	search: 'Search creatives, brands and creators',
	home: { label: 'Go home', href: '/' },
	footer,
}

export type NotFoundContent = typeof notFoundContent
